prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: final outdoor pavement concept board for an existing 2D top-down prison industrial compound game.
Input images: Image 1 is the base scene to preserve, including its actual room layout, wall geometry, props and grass. Image 2 is ONLY a scope guide: red strokes indicate outdoor connecting walkways; do not retain or reproduce any red marks.
Primary request: redesign ONLY the exterior circulation pavement to visually distinguish it clearly from all indoor tile floors. Use the exact map relationships in the references: dormitories and reading room on left, bath and infirmary at top, exercise courtyard at upper right, first workshop in center, second workshop to right, and lower connecting corridor.
Composition: polished landscape art direction board, a large dominant overhead in-game effect view (about 75% of board) plus a narrow bottom strip of THREE close-up material details. Crop away ALL editor application UI, selection circles, selection markers, cursor, status labels and toolbars. Enlarge the map field of Image 1 for the main view; retain its axis-aligned high overhead 2.5D camera, existing scale relationships, and hand-painted outlined game style. Clean cream margin, not a fake app screenshot.
Road treatment: old factory poured concrete, medium warm neutral grey / taupe, noticeably warmer and rougher than the pale cool green-grey indoor square ceramic tiles. LARGE sparse concrete construction bays and expansion joints, approximately 3–4 times the indoor tile pitch, with brushed concrete grain, modest worn edges, a few thin repaired cracks and slight tonal variation. At intersections keep the same concrete surface, no crossing grid of little ceramic tiles. Flat flush threshold transitions at every doorway, each interior remains visibly its own material. Do not widen, narrow, move, or block any passage.
Edges: restrained narrow flush stone edging against grassy outer borders; intermittent flush dark steel drain grates and shallow drainage channels beside exterior walls. Keep drainage and edging clear of door openings and flush with the road. A few weathered rectangular patch repairs, restrained edge dirt and grass at the grass border. The central walking zone stays clean and readable.
Preserve every room's interior flooring, furniture, walls and original position. Keep courtyard sports floor and court lines as currently shown. Leave the existing grass as grass. No new building, no new trees, no cars, no NPC, no additional gameplay props.
Bottom close-ups: (1) dry brushed poured concrete with one large expansion seam and a small repair; (2) concrete meeting grass with a low narrow stone edging and drain grate; (3) a room doorway transition from warm rough outdoor concrete to cool small indoor tiles, smooth flat transition with no step blocking the door.
Text: a modest board title exactly "园区室外道路 · 旧水泥路面", and three compact detail captions exactly "大块水泥面", "路沿与排水", "室内外过渡". Do not add any other explanatory text or callout arrows.
Lighting: same neutral daylight as existing game, controlled soft shadows. Avoid photorealistic gravel noise, shiny wet puddles, pristine luxury plaza, asphalt highway lane markings, yellow route arrows, brick cobbles, moss overgrowth in the walking center, dramatic isometric camera, ornate borders, extra room layouts. This is a coherent playable game-art pavement proposal, not a new map design.
